headline: A new Ontario company, one Purified Water package in polypropylene with PVC pretreatment
lead: Built for makers of pharmaceuticals, medical devices and natural health products, and for contract manufacturers. Our team: a commercial lead, an automation engineer with pharmaceutical water experience and a modular manufacturing and design specialist.

rows.v: One modular Purified Water package in polypropylene, with polyvinyl chloride (PVC) pretreatment: pretreatment to distribution, design to service. Purified Water only. Natural PP is rated 0 to 80 °C, and its pressure rating falls as it heats. Not Water for Injection, pure steam or stainless steel systems; not residential or municipal

items.q: What happens to our system if a key person leaves?
items.a: The knowledge is in the records: specification, as-built drawings, [PP joint records kept], software backup, factory acceptance test (FAT) and qualification reports. You receive them at handover, so whoever takes over works from them.

items.q: Do you supply hospital, lab or industrial water?
items.a: Our scope: [hospital water scope]; [lab water scope]; [industrial water scope]. Hospital reprocessing water follows CSA Z314:23 and ANSI/AAMI ST108:2023. Critical water under ST108 is looser on ions than Purified Water, tighter on microbes, and has an endotoxin limit.

items.q: Do you work on other makers' systems?
items.a: For [makes and equipment types serviced]: service and upgrades, starting with a condition survey or an assessment.
